Shared test target rule (overview S5): finish only after swift build --build-tests passes, then re-run the focused tests last. Before declaring blocked on foreign diagnostics, wait at least 2 minutes and retry up to 3 times.
Test-integrity rule (overview S4): no deleted, skipped or loosened assertions, except P03-S1. Red-green evidence for every behaviour fix.
Tests and smoke runs never write to ~/.local/stria or into the repository tree outside tmp/.
No secret values are printed, logged, stored or committed.
Commit messages carry no AI tool attribution or co-authorship lines (repository policy).
Run verification commands in the foreground and keep complete logs with exit codes under the evidenceRoot.
designDecisionsAndRationale: Fuzzy trigrams are de-duplicated across the question and then capped at 64. The builder is correct; the test's cap case is the defect (P03-S1).
pdf-text-layer NFKC-normalizes PDFPage.string, because ligature glyphs are layout artifacts. Model OCR output is stored as returned (P05-S1).
withTestDataRoot creates only the temp root (0700), so fixtures can write inputs while first-use directory creation stays tested (P04-S1).

At c7f2697, GatewayACPAgent wraps executor errors as ACPError.internalError, so a CLI-vendor launch failure is failed (exit 5), not unavailable. The dead mapping is removed (P05-S2). Design and reference were corrected in session-245 Step 4.
Locked means isLocked (a user password is required). Owner-password-only PDFs are accepted (P04-S4). Design clarified in session-245 Step 4.
View models live in StriaCore/AppModel; no new target.
HEIC 0.75 with JPEG fallback; system SQLite3 with an FTS5 trigram probe and LIKE fallback; cursor-api preflight is unavailable.
intentionalTradeoffs: All plans share one StriaCoreTests target. Parallel workers wait and retry on foreign diagnostics; post-join serial verification decides.
Default vendor anthropic with ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is applied pending user confirmation (design-docs/user-qa/default-agent-config.md).
A missing CLI vendor executable marks OCR pages failed (retryable) instead of leaving them pending.
LIKE fallback search scores 0 and orders by document and page.
The agent-gateway call path is verified by build and manual use only.
supportedEdgeCases: Re-importing the same bytes is idempotent; id-prefix collision fails with idCollision; an interrupted rendering import resumes.
OCR unavailable: import succeeds with pages pending and no agent_runs rows.
Questions with repeated tokens produce de-duplicated trigrams; questions with more than 64 distinct trigrams are capped in first-occurrence order.
PDF text layers with ligatures (U+FB00-FB06) are stored and searched as plain letters.
LIKE search treats % and _ literally; a full-width query matches ASCII text and the reverse.
Locked PDFs are rejected with invalidPDF; owner-password-only PDFs are accepted.
CLIJSON error envelopes stay valid JSON for messages containing quotes, backslashes and newlines.
--help and --version never create the data root; --home beats STRIA_HOME.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Encrypted PDFs that need a password.
Document deletion, schema migrations beyond v1, and downgrade of a newer database.
Distinguishing a missing CLI vendor executable from other gateway failures.
Real vendor network calls in tests.
Packaging stria-app as a signed .app bundle.
